title: Should have, could have, must have
titleEn: Past modals: should have, could have, must have, might have, can't have
explanation:
**модальне + have + V3**: *should have done, could have gone, must have left*
- **−** *shouldn't have / might not have / can't have / couldn't have* + V3
- **?** *Should I have told her? Could they have forgotten?*

У розмові: *should've, could've, must've, might've* — пишемо have, ніколи ~~should of~~.
Дія в процесі: *must have been + V-ing*: *You must have been dreaming.*

guide.idea: Модальне + have + V3 — щоб оцінювати минуле: шкодувати й дорікати (should have), казати про згаяну можливість (could have) або здогадуватися, що сталося (must / might / can't have).

use.note: should have — було б правильно, але не зробили; shouldn't have — зробили, а не треба було.
use.en: I should have booked the tickets earlier.

use.note: could have — могли б, проте не сталося.
use.en: We could have walked to Shevchenko Park — it's only ten minutes.
use.uk: Ми могли б піти до парку Шевченка пішки — тут лише десять хвилин.

use.note: could have — небезпека, якої вдалося уникнути.
use.en: Be careful! You could have fallen.
The ground is wet — it must have rained.

use.note: might / may have — один з варіантів.
use.en: She might have missed the train to Kyiv.
use.uk: Можливо, вона не встигла на потяг до Києва.

use.en: He can't have finished already — he only started at 10.
use.uk: Він не міг уже закінчити — він почав лише о 10-й.

a.en: I should have gone to the meeting.

b.en: I had to go to the meeting.

a.en: I could have bought it, but I didn't.
a.uk: Я міг би це купити, але не купив.

b.en: Oksana could swim when she was five.
b.uk: Оксана вміла плавати в п'ять років.

mistakes.why: should've на слух схоже на «should of», але пишемо have.
Після have — третя форма (come, gone, seen), а не друга.
«Не міг бачити» у здогаді — can't have; mustn't have так не вживаємо.

mistakes.wrong: I must have gone to the dentist yesterday.
mistakes.right: I had to go to the dentist yesterday.
mistakes.why: «Мусив піти» — обов'язок, had to; must have — лише здогад.

examples.en: I should have listened to you.
The streets are wet. It must have rained.
Taras isn't here yet. He might have got lost.
She can't have seen us — she didn't say hello.
examples.uk: Вона не могла нас бачити — не привіталася.

examples.en: We shouldn't have stayed up so late.
examples.uk: Не треба було так пізно лягати.

exercises.prompt: I failed the test. I ___ more.
The ground is wet. It ___ in the night.
You ___ the whole cake! It was huge!
Why did you walk? You ___ a taxi.
I'm so tired. I ___ (not / should) have gone to bed so late.
exercises.explanation: Жаль про минуле — shouldn't have + V3.

exercises.prompt: She didn't answer. She ___ have been asleep. (можливо)
exercises.explanation: Можливо, так було — might / may / could have + V3.

exercises.prompt: He knows everything. Somebody ___ have told him. (впевнений)
exercises.explanation: Впевнений висновок про минуле — must have + V3.

exercises.sentence: I should of called you earlier.
You must have saw the news.

exercises.explanation: Докір за минуле — should have + V3.

exercises.prompt: It was a mistake to buy this car.
answer: I shouldn't have bought this car.
I should not have bought this car.
We shouldn't have bought this car.
exercises.explanation: Жаль про минуле — shouldn't have + V3.

answer: He must have forgotten about the meeting.
He must have forgotten the meeting.
He must've forgotten about the meeting.
exercises.explanation: Впевнений висновок про минуле — must have + V3.
